text: Figure 3.99: Example Software Cluster Each of the composition software component types called ”CSWCT05”, ”CSWCT07”, ”CSWCT08”, ”CSWCT09”, ”CSWCT10” and ”CSWCT11” contain three atomic software component prototypes. The names of these atomic software component prototypes are following the rule ”aSwcPt##”. The placeholder ”##”, representing a two digit number with leading zero, ranges from 01 to 18. For example, the composition software component type ”CSWCT05” contains the three atomic software component prototypes called ”aSwcPt01”, ”aSwcPt02” and ”aSwcPt03”. Any of the atomic software component types have an internal behavior and each of those internal behaviors consists of three runnable entities named ”re#ASWCT##”; for example, the name ”re1ASWCT05” denotes the first runnable entity of the atomic software component type five (5). An RTE Event — Timing Event — is specified for each of the runnable entities, and is named as follows: ”teRe#ASWCT##”. The described software system consists of two software clusters called ”Software Cluster A” and ”Software Cluster B”. This is shown in the Figure 3.100. The software cluster A consists of the composition software components ”cSwcPt04”, ”cSwcPt05”, ”cSwcPt07”, ”cSwcPt08” and ”cSwcPt10”. And the software cluster B consists of the composition software components ”cSwcPt09” and ”cSwcPt11”.
